text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Brooch
text_block_list.text:
—So you see, tons and tons! Even after I 
move up to the Senior Class, I want to run 
lots and loooots of races!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Brooch
text_block_list.text:
"Because I love running! I want everyone 
to see me run a whole bunch! Hey, do you 
think I can?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—That's true. Let's work together so we 
can do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we begin? Everything that 
Mother taught me, I shall now pass on to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Brooch
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Thank you, Messiah!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Over here is Messiah-san... ...and a 
young Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (And then—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! You kept up right until the 
end! You've got some serious guts, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're quite stoic. Hehe, I like girls 
like you!

text_block_list.name: Feather-Adorned Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Phew... but I can 
still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Those are good eyes. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I won't go easy on you. Try to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Over here is Daring Heart and the 
others!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone, they're all—leaving something 
behind. Passing it along!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, this is what Tiara 
Umamusume are! The dazzling lineage we 
weave together!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. I'm so jealous, everyone is so 
wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I've found Cesario... Messiah-san, and 
Heart-san, too.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Then, will I be able to find 'myself' too?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Will it be today? Or tomorrow? Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to this—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm super…… looking forward to it……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Homeroom roll call has 
already started, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Craft, isn't she awake yet?

...Today marks the long-awaited start of 
summer camp. As for Rhein Kraft, she 
seemed quite pumped up even before 
departing, but—

Having fallen asleep at some point during 
the bus ride, she showed no signs of 
waking up even after arriving at our 
destination.
choice_data_list: Was this girl always such a sleepyhead...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. There is something I would 
like to bring to your attention.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's about Rhein Kraft's condition.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Unya... mnya?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Where am... hmmm?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the training camp lodge?! H-Huh, 
where's the bus... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hu- Ah, yes?!

To Line Craft, who was completely out of 
the loop, I explained the situation for 
now. That she hadn't woken up, that I had 
carried her all the way here, and—
choice_data_list: I'll go get checked out tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: An ex... am? ...Um, what kind?
choice_data_list:
You need to get yourself checked out at 
least once, no matter what.

You need to get yourself checked out at 
least once, no matter what.

text_block_list.text:
I continue with, "I heard from Cesario." 
About how she's been suddenly falling 
asleep like that lately and having a hard 
time waking up.

Falling asleep suddenly... and the time 
until waking up is, little by little, 
beginning to grow longer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So... an examination, huh? U-Umm...
choice_data_list:
It's also to make sure that nothing's 
wrong.

text_block_list.text:
Since the only symptom seems to be 
"falling asleep," it's likely hard for her 
to feel a sense of urgency.

However, Rhein Kraft's physical well-being 
is of utmost importance. Even if it seems 
like an overreaction, it's always best to 
address things early.

And so, the next day. I practically 
dragged a still-unconvinced Rhein Kraft to 
the hospital, but—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, good work today. It must have been 
tough with all those tests all day long.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not at all! So, um, what were the 
results...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...For now, absolutely no 
abnormalities were found. You're the very 
picture of health.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that, Trainer! That means I 
can get back to training tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I want to train as hard as I can until 
the Sprinters Stakes...!"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Well, even so, there is still much we 
don't know about you Umamusume. Please 
continue to keep a close eye on them, 
Trainer.

We leave the hospital and decide to head 
back to the camp. Perhaps relieved to know 
that nothing was wrong, Rhein Kraft walked 
with a remarkably light step.
choice_data_list:
(To be honest, I'm still worried about 
this side, but...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Um, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making you worry. But I—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, while I'm asleep, it seems like I'm 
having all sorts of dreams, though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, every single one is a wonderful 
dream! I forget them when I wake up, 
though... but that warm, fuzzy, happy 
feeling stays with me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, lately whenever I wake up, I 
find myself thinking, 'I want to see the 
rest of that dream.' I never remember what 
it was about, so it feels kinda strange."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So, um... I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm totally fine! More importantly, 
let's do our best together at training 
camp!”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head ho――... Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! The sunset is so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This might be the perfect photo op. 
Hehe... alright!

And hoping to capture the sunset, Rhein 
Kraft began walking toward the sun.

As if nothing had happened, she smiled 
happily as she always did.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Look, look! I got a great photo!

—Because she was like that, I was drawn to 
follow after her, stepping up to walk 
right by her side.

"What kind of training should we do 
starting tomorrow? What strategy should we 
use for the next race? By the way, what 
should we do on our rest days?"

Exchanging countless bits of harmless 
chit-chat like that with Rhein Kraft.
